150	 * @param options - bracket owner, stability rule, and optional durability checkpoint.
151	 * @param signal - optional summarization cancellation signal.
152	 * @returns the successful durable compaction result.
153	 */
154	export async function compactSurfaceRegion(
155	  dependencies: RegionDependencies,
156	  session: Session,
157	  start: number,
158	  end: number,
159	  agent: Agent,
160	  options: CompactionTransactionOptions,
161	  signal?: AbortSignal,
162	): Promise<CompactionResult> {
163	  if (options.owner === null) signal?.throwIfAborted()
164	  const selection = validateSurfaceRegion(session, start, end)
165	  const entryState = inspectCompactionEntryState(session.events)
166	  assertCompactionInactive(
167	    entryState.unmatchedCompactionStart,
168	    entryState.latestEndSeedSeq,
169	    'compaction',
170	  )
171	
172	  let owner: number | null
173	  if (options.owner === null) {
174	    if (entryState.openTurn !== null) {
175	      throw new ManualCompactionError('busy', 'manual compaction: the session already has an open turn')
176	    }
177	    owner = null
178	  } else {
179	    if (entryState.openTurn === null) {
180	      throw new Error('compactRegion: no open turn — automatic compaction events must be enclosed in a turn')
181	    }
182	    owner = entryState.openTurn
183	  }
184	
185	  const compactionId = CompactionId(randomUUID())
186	  const lifecycle = {
187	    compactionId,
188	    ...options.sourceCommandId === undefined ? {} : { sourceCommandId: options.sourceCommandId },
189	    turn: owner,
190	  }
191	  const startEvent = session.append('compaction/start', lifecycle)
192	  const assertStable: StabilityCheck = options.stability === 'whole-surface'
193	    ? assertWholeSurfaceUnchanged
194	    : assertSelectedSpanStable
195	  let failure: TransactionFailure | undefined
196	  let flushFailure: unknown
197	  let result: CompactionResult | undefined
198	  let closed = false
199	  let closing = false
200	  let stage: TransactionFailure['stage'] = 'summary'
201	
202	  try {
203	    const prepared = prepareCompaction(dependencies, session, selection)
204	    const summarized = await summarizeCompaction(
205	      dependencies,
206	      prepared,
207	      agent,
208	      compactionId,
209	      options.sourceCommandId,
210	      signal,
211	    )
212	    if (options.owner === null) signal?.throwIfAborted()
213	    assertStable(dependencies, session, summarized)
214	    stage = 'commit'
215	    const pending = commitCompactionBody(session, startEvent, summarized)
216	    closing = true
217	    const endEvent = session.append('compaction/end', lifecycle)
218	    closed = true
219	    result = completeCompaction(pending, endEvent)
220	  } catch (error: unknown) {
221	    failure = { error, stage: closing ? 'commit' : stage }
222	    if (!closing) {
223	      closing = true
224	      try {
225	        session.append('compaction/end', { ...lifecycle, error: errorChain(error) })
226	        closed = true
227	      } catch (closeError: unknown) {
228	        failure = { error: closeError, stage: 'commit' }
229	      }
230	    }
231	  }
232	
233	  if (closed && options.flush !== undefined) {
234	    try {
235	      await options.flush()
236	    } catch (error: unknown) {
237	      flushFailure = error
238	    }
239	  }
240	
241	  if (options.owner === null) signal?.throwIfAborted()
242	  if (failure !== undefined) {
243	    if (options.owner === null) throwManualFailure(failure)
244	    throw failure.error
245	  }
246	  if (flushFailure !== undefined) {
247	    throw new ManualCompactionError(
248	      'persistence',
249	      'manual compaction durability checkpoint failed',
250	      { cause: flushFailure },
251	    )
252	  }
253	  /* v8 ignore next -- every path without a result records and throws a failure above. */
254	  if (result === undefined) throw new Error('compaction committed without a result')
255	  return result
256	}
257	
258	/** Classify one closed manual attempt without weakening cancellation precedence. */
259	function throwManualFailure(failure: TransactionFailure): never {
260	  if (failure.stage === 'commit') {
261	    throw new ManualCompactionError(
262	      'commit',
263	      'manual compaction did not commit cleanly',
264	      { cause: failure.error },
265	    )
266	  }
267	  if (failure.error instanceof SurfaceChangedError) {
268	    throw new ManualCompactionError(
269	      'changed',
270	      'the compacted history changed during manual compaction',
271	      { cause: failure.error },
272	    )
273	  }
274	  throw new ManualCompactionError(
275	    'summary',
276	    'manual compaction could not produce a smaller summary',
277	    { cause: failure.error },
278	  )
279	}

281	/**
282	 * Reject a durable unmatched compaction marker unless a later constructor-seed
283	 * boundary proves that its owner belongs to an earlier session lifecycle.
284	 * @param unmatchedCompactionStart - latest unmatched opening marker, if any.
285	 * @param latestEndSeedSeq - newest constructor-seed boundary, if any.
286	 * @param stage - operation label included in the busy diagnostic.
287	 */
288	function assertCompactionInactive(
289	  unmatchedCompactionStart: SessionEvent<'compaction/start'> | undefined,
290	  latestEndSeedSeq: number | undefined,
291	  stage: string,
292	): void {
293	  if (unmatchedCompactionStart === undefined
294	    || (latestEndSeedSeq !== undefined
295	      && latestEndSeedSeq > unmatchedCompactionStart.seq)) return
296	  throw new ManualCompactionError(
297	    'busy',
298	    `${stage}: compaction already in progress; the session compaction lock is already active`,
299	  )
300	}
301	
302	/**
303	 * Recheck the durable compaction lock after an asynchronous policy decision.
304	 * @param session - session whose latest marker state is inspected.
305	 * @param stage - operation label included in the busy diagnostic.
306	 */
307	export function assertNoActiveCompaction(session: Session, stage: string): void {
308	  const entryState = inspectCompactionEntryState(session.events)
309	  assertCompactionInactive(
310	    entryState.unmatchedCompactionStart,
311	    entryState.latestEndSeedSeq,
312	    stage,
313	  )
314	}

316	/** Validate one requested surface-position span before asynchronous work begins. */
317	function validateSurfaceRegion(session: Session, start: number, end: number): SurfaceSelection {
318	  const nodes = session.surface.nodes
319	  const startIdx = nodes.indexOf(start)
320	  const endIdx = nodes.indexOf(end)
321	  if (startIdx === -1) throw new Error(`compactRegion: start seq ${start} not found in surface`)
322	  if (endIdx === -1) throw new Error(`compactRegion: end seq ${end} not found in surface`)
323	  if (startIdx > endIdx) {
324	    throw new Error(
325	      `compactRegion: start seq ${start} (position ${startIdx}) is after end seq ${end} (position ${endIdx}) on the surface`,
326	    )
327	  }
328	  // oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-non-null-assertion
329	  if (!toolPairingBalancedBefore(session, nodes[startIdx]!)) {
330	    throw new Error(`compactRegion: start seq ${start} is not a balanced boundary (would split a step's tool-call/result pair)`)
331	  }
332	  // oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-non-null-assertion
333	  if (!toolPairingBalancedAfter(session, nodes[endIdx]!)) {
334	    throw new Error(`compactRegion: end seq ${end} is not a balanced boundary (would split a step, or the step is still open)`)
335	  }
336	
337	  return { start, end, startIdx, endIdx, shadowedSeqs: nodes.slice(startIdx, endIdx + 1) }
338	}

340	/** Snapshot pricing and replay input for a validated surface range. */
341	function prepareCompaction(
342	  dependencies: RegionDependencies,
343	  session: Session,
344	  selection: SurfaceSelection,
345	): PreparedCompaction {
346	  const measurement = dependencies.meter.measure(session)
347	  const selectedNodes = measurement.nodes.slice(selection.startIdx, selection.endIdx + 1)
348	  if (selectedNodes.length !== selection.shadowedSeqs.length
349	    || selectedNodes.some((node, index) => node.seq !== selection.shadowedSeqs[index])) {
350	    throw new SurfaceChangedError('compaction: selected surface changed before summarization began')
351	  }
352	  return {
353	    ...selection,
354	    measurement,
355	    selectedNodes,
356	    // The shadow-price protocol prices replacements with the fixed heuristic
357	    // so the O(1) projection fold stays in agreement with its own appends;
358	    // retention, range selection, and the shrink comparison read the
359	    // route-priced `tokens` instead.
360	    shadowedTokenCount: selectedNodes.reduce((total, node) => total + node.heuristicTokens, 0),
361	    shadowedRouteTokenCount: selectedNodes.reduce((total, node) => total + node.tokens, 0),
362	    input: buildSummarizationInput(session, selection.shadowedSeqs),
363	  }
364	}

366	/** Run the summarizer and frame its replacement checkpoint. */
367	async function summarizeCompaction(
368	  dependencies: RegionDependencies,
369	  prepared: PreparedCompaction,
370	  agent: Agent,
371	  compactionId: CompactionResult['compactionId'],
372	  sourceCommandId: CommandId | undefined,
373	  signal?: AbortSignal,
374	): Promise<SummarizedCompaction> {
375	  const summaryResult = await dependencies.summarize(prepared.input, agent, signal)
376	  const checkpointMessage = createUserMessage({
377	    content: frameSummary(summaryResult.summary),
378	    source: compactCheckpointSource(compactionId, sourceCommandId),
379	  })
380	  // The checkpoint is text-only, so its fixed-heuristic price IS its route
381	  // price; comparing it against the span's route price asks the real
382	  // question — does the replacement lower the next request's pressure.
383	  const framedSummaryTokenCount = dependencies.meter.estimateMessage(checkpointMessage)
384	  if (framedSummaryTokenCount >= prepared.shadowedRouteTokenCount) {
385	    throw new Error(
386	      `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (${framedSummaryTokenCount} estimated framed tokens >= ${prepared.shadowedRouteTokenCount})`,
387	    )
388	  }
389	  return {
390	    ...prepared,
391	    ...summaryResult,
392	    checkpointMessage,
393	  }
394	}

396	/** Reject a summary prepared against any earlier surface generation. */
397	function assertWholeSurfaceUnchanged(
398	  dependencies: RegionDependencies,
399	  session: Session,
400	  prepared: PreparedCompaction,
401	): void {
402	  const current = dependencies.meter.measure(session)
403	  if (!isDeepStrictEqual(current.nodes, prepared.measurement.nodes)) {
404	    throw new SurfaceChangedError('compaction: session surface changed during summarization')
405	  }
406	}

408	/**
409	 * Require only that the selected span remain the same present, contiguous,
410	 * equally priced, balanced replacement target. Nodes added outside it remain
411	 * visible and do not invalidate the summary.
412	 */
413	function assertSelectedSpanStable(
414	  dependencies: RegionDependencies,
415	  session: Session,
416	  prepared: PreparedCompaction,
417	): void {
418	  let current: SurfaceSelection
419	  try {
420	    current = validateSurfaceRegion(session, prepared.start, prepared.end)
421	  } catch (error: unknown) {
422	    throw new SurfaceChangedError(
423	      'compaction: the selected span is no longer a valid replacement target',
424	      { cause: error },
425	    )
426	  }
427	  if (!isDeepStrictEqual([...current.shadowedSeqs], [...prepared.shadowedSeqs])) {
428	    throw new SurfaceChangedError('compaction: the selected span changed during summarization')
429	  }
430	  const measured = dependencies.meter.measure(session).nodes.slice(current.startIdx, current.endIdx + 1)
431	  if (!isDeepStrictEqual(measured, prepared.selectedNodes)) {
432	    throw new SurfaceChangedError('compaction: the selected span was rewritten during summarization')
433	  }
434	}

436	/** Append one completed summary record and replacement body without yielding. */
437	function commitCompactionBody(
438	  session: Session,
439	  startEvent: SessionEvent<'compaction/start'>,
440	  summarized: SummarizedCompaction,
441	): Omit<CompactionResult, 'endSeq'> {
442	  const {
443	    start,
444	    end,
445	    shadowedSeqs,
446	    shadowedTokenCount,
447	    summary,
448	    provider,
449	    model,
450	    maxTokens,
451	    usage,
452	    checkpointMessage,
453	  } = summarized
454	  const callProvenance = summarized.llmStreamCall === true
455	    ? { rawOutput: summarized.rawOutput, llmStreamCall: true as const }
456	    : summarized.rawOutput === undefined ? {} : { rawOutput: summarized.rawOutput }
457	  const summaryEvent = session.append('compaction/summary', {
458	    compactionId: startEvent.data.compactionId,
459	    ...startEvent.data.sourceCommandId === undefined
460	      ? {}
461	      : { sourceCommandId: startEvent.data.sourceCommandId },
462	    summary,
463	    ...callProvenance,
464	    shadowedRange: { start, end },
465	    shadowedSeqs: [...shadowedSeqs],
466	    shadowedTokenCount,
467	    provider,
468	    model,
469	    ...maxTokens === undefined ? {} : { maxTokens },
470	    ...usage === undefined ? {} : { usage },
471	  })
472	  session.append('user/message', checkpointMessage, {
473	    surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', start, end },
474	    sourceEventSeqs: [startEvent.seq, summaryEvent.seq, ...shadowedSeqs],
475	  })
476	  return {
477	    compactionId: startEvent.data.compactionId,
478	    ...startEvent.data.sourceCommandId === undefined
479	      ? {}
480	      : { sourceCommandId: startEvent.data.sourceCommandId },
481	    startSeq: startEvent.seq,
482	    summarySeq: summaryEvent.seq,
483	    summary,
484	    shadowedRange: { start, end },
485	    shadowedSeqs: [...shadowedSeqs],
486	    shadowedTokenCount,
487	  }
488	}
